name: multi-app-change
title: Multi-app change
about: Tier B on a project with SEVERAL apps (R4, BOSSAPP-1432). The customer's projects hold several apps; ours held one, and New work quietly built a fresh app on main beside them. The gate first starts New work with no app chosen and requires BOSS to ask (422 app_selection_required, Choose an application / Create a new app). It then starts the same change for one app (BOSS_E2E_APP, else the project's newest app) and requires the build's resolved base (code_task.base_branch_resolved) to be that app's branch from New work's plan — never the bare default branch for an open change. Needs a project with at least two built apps (BOSS_E2E_PROJECT).
change: Add a small 'About' page reachable from the main navigation. It shows the app's name and one sentence on what it is for. Keep every existing page and test working; add one test that the About page renders.
acceptance_criteria: An About page is reachable from the main navigation and shows the app's name and purpose.
Everything that worked before still works: the app's existing tests still pass.
A test covers the About page.
